player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Connect Four.
Your disc symbol: {symbol}.
player_prompt.board_details: The game board has {num_rows} rows and {num_cols} columns.
player_prompt.description: Players take turns dropping their disc into one of the columns (0 to {end_col}).
player_prompt.goal: The first to connect (their own) four discs vertically, horizontally, or diagonally wins.
player_prompt.instruction:
On your turn, enter the column number in squared brackets to make your move.
For example: '[col 4]' or '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: The game board is not visible to players.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Invalid action format. Expected format: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is full.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} dropped their disk ({player_symbol}) into column {col}.
